_status: PARTIAL DOCUMENTATION OF A SHAPE — no validator (jsonschema/ajv) reads this file directly; most fields here are presence/type-checked only, loosely not exactly matching this schema. Two exceptions, added 2026-08-23 (P8-081) as the single enforcement point for what this file declares: `visual_id`'s `pattern` and `reader_question`'s `minLength` ARE independently enforced in code by validateVisualJob() (adapters/echarts/validate.mjs, gate G-STRUCT, VISUAL_ID_PATTERN / READER_QUESTION_MIN_LENGTH) — kept in sync by hand, not by a shared reader, so a change to either side needs the other updated too.
title: Normalized visual job packet

text_summary.description: required before entering a source-of-truth document (Gate G7)

data.description: shape-specific: {dimensions,source} | {items} | {rows,cols,matrix} | {nodes,links} | {root} | {events} | {categories,values} | {axes,series}. Table-shaped data (scatter, bubble, timeline) may add `names` (one label per row — WITHOUT it a dot is an anonymous circle), `notes` (one plain sentence per row) and, for bubble, `size_label` (what the third measure is); `names` and `notes` must correspond one to one with `source` (gate G-STRUCT).

semantic_colors.description: Default true. When at least two labels of a chart are severity or status words and they are at least half of its labels, those labels take the reserved severity / status colours from the theme (Critical red … Low blue … Info green); set false to keep the categorical palette.
